movie:1032950.overview: In a monastery cut off from the world, the monks run a clinic for the possessed. One day, a young policeman Marek comes to the convent. Posing as a clergyman, he penetrates monastic life and tries to explain the recent, mysterious disappearance of several tormented inmates. It turns out, however, that there is no way out of the monastery.
movie:1032950.title: Hellhole

movie:10550.overview: Jeremiah Ecks, an FBI agent, realizes that he must join with his lifelong enemy, Agent Sever, a rogue DIA agent with whom he is in mortal combat, in order to defeat a common enemy. That enemy has developed a "micro-device" that can be injected into victims in order to kill them at will.
movie:10550.tagline: Your most dangerous enemies are the friends you've double-crossed.
movie:10550.title: Ballistic: Ecks vs. Sever

movie:1069650.overview: 1899. On a stormy night, Aimée, a young Republican schoolteacher, arrives in a snowy hamlet on the edge of the Alps. Despite the mistrust of the inhabitants, she is determined to shed light on their dark beliefs. As she blends into the life of the community, a sensual vertigo grows within her.
movie:1069650.title: The Girl in the Snow

movie:10750.overview: After federal agents arrest a drug czar and put him on trial, the cartel leader's vicious son storms a prep school and takes its students hostage. They rebel against the armed intruders and try to take back their academy by any means necessary.
movie:10750.tagline: They've Always been REBELS - TODAY, They Become HEROES.
movie:10750.title: Toy Soldiers

movie:114750.overview: A campus culture war between blacks and whites at a predominantly white Ivy League college comes to a head when the staff of a satirical magazine stages an offensive Halloween party.
movie:114750.tagline: A satire about being a black face in a white place.
movie:114750.title: Dear White People

movie:1290450.overview: At the end of summer, Clémence tells her ex-husband that she’s had relationships with women. Her life is turned upside down when he files to strip her of their son’s custody. Then begins a struggle of several years for Clémence to defend her right to be a mother and a woman – free to make her own choices.
movie:1290450.title: Love Me Tender

movie:1312150.overview: Ricky Gervais tackles life, death and the state of the world in a brutally honest special that spares no topic, even his own mortality.
movie:1312150.title: Ricky Gervais: Mortality

movie:1398050.overview: A group of teens hit the road in a stolen driver's ed car, racing against time to help a lovesick high school senior track down his college-freshman girlfriend and win her back.
movie:1398050.tagline: Follow your heart... and the rules of the road.
movie:1398050.title: Driver's Ed

movie:1440050.overview: After his wife Katie lands a once-in-a-lifetime deal on Shark Tank that takes her on a prolonged business trip - lifelong breadwinner Nate Wilcox now has to fend for his family as a first-time stay-at-home dad.
movie:1440050.tagline: One dad. Three kids. Zero clue.
movie:1440050.title: The Breadwinner

movie:1450.overview: On the surface, Saya is a stunning 16-year-old, but that youthful exterior hides the tormented soul of a 400-year-old "halfling". Born to a human father and a vampire mother, she has for centuries been a loner obsessed with using her samurai skills to rid the world of vampires, all the while knowing that she herself can survive only on blood like those she hunts.
movie:1450.title: Blood: The Last Vampire

movie:1546050.overview: A violent and reckless samurai is shipwrecked on a remote island left without an avenue for his rage. After undertaking a spiritual journey to appease his aggressive thoughts, he finds himself abducted by external demons taking the form of cannibals, putting his sense of reality and deadly talents to the test.
movie:1546050.title: Lone Samurai

movie:1646950.overview: After mysteriously inheriting her parents house, a lifelong orphan finds a camcorder and a collection of video tapes containing the gruesome secrets of her family's past, and the horrifying truth behind the camcorder they were captured on.
movie:1646950.title: Capture

movie:20850.overview: Ilsa, a warden at a Nazi death camp that conducts experiments on prisoners, strives to prove that women can withstand more pain and suffering than men, and therefore should be allowed to fight on the frontlines.
movie:20850.tagline: The most dreaded Nazi of them all!
movie:20850.title: Ilsa: She Wolf of the SS

cast.c: Jack the Ripper - John Leslie Stevenson

movie:24750.overview: Writer H. G. Wells pursues Jack the Ripper to modern day San Francisco after the infamous serial killer steals his time machine to escape the 19th century.
movie:24750.tagline: H.G. Wells Races Through Time To Catch Jack The Ripper!
movie:24750.title: Time After Time

movie:25050.overview: A family gathers together for a commemorative ritual whose nature only gradually becomes clear.
movie:25050.title: Still Walking

trailer.name: STILL WALKING Trailer (2008) - The Criterion Collection

movie:269650.overview: The Third World War (2099–2126) devastated part of the Earth. Former nations are reforming while new powers emerge, and groups of humans struggle to survive in ruined cities. The story follows Deunan Knute and her partner Briareos as they search for the legendary city of Olympus.
movie:269650.tagline: To find Olympus, they must fight to survive.
movie:269650.title: Appleseed Alpha

movie:302150.overview: An assassin forges an unlikely partnership with one of his targets: a woman seeking revenge for the murder of her family.
movie:302150.title: The Hunter's Prayer

movie:36950.overview: Controversy and legal problems follow Dr. Jack Kevorkian as he advocates assisted suicide.
movie:36950.tagline: Is this the face of a killer?
movie:36950.title: You Don't Know Jack

trailer.name: You Don't Know Jack: Trailer #3 (HBO Films)

movie:557950.overview: A young woman thinks she’s found a path to internet stardom when she starts making YouTube videos with a charismatic stranger  – until the dark side of viral celebrity threatens to ruin them both.
movie:557950.title: Mainstream

movie:732450.overview: Bruce Wayne faces a deadly menace from his past, with the help of three former classmates: world-renowned martial artists Richard Dragon, Ben Turner and Lady Shiva.
movie:732450.tagline: Get ready for the ultimate showdown.
movie:732450.title: Batman: Soul of the Dragon

movie:910850.overview: Hathaway Noa plans his attack on the Adelaide Conference while Federation officer Kenneth Sleg prepares to defend it. With each man pursuing his own goal, Gigi Andalucia heads to Hong Kong to fulfill a role of her own.
movie:910850.title: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM HATHAWAY The Sorcery of Nymph Circe

movie:938150.overview: He’s a Wardriver: a hacker who steals from banks, not people—until he’s noticed. Now the money turns violent, and the woman caught in it could save him or kill them both.
movie:938150.title: Wardriver

tv:1450.overview: Deputy Police Chief Brenda Leigh Johnson transfers from Atlanta to LA to head up a special unit of the LAPD that handles sensitive, high-profile murder cases. Johnson's quirky personality and hard-nosed approach often rubs her colleagues the wrong way, but her reputation as one of the world's best interrogator eventually wins over even her toughest critics.
tv:1450.tagline: They'll bring you in. She'll make you talk.
tv:1450.title: The Closer

tv:1950.overview: After the death of his wife, world-class neurosurgeon Dr. Andrew Brown leaves Manhattan and moves his family to the small town of Everwood, Colorado. There he becomes a small-town doctor and learns parenting on the fly as he raises his talented but resentful 15-year-old son Ephram and his 9-year-old daughter Delia.
tv:1950.title: Everwood

tv:196950.overview: In a world where only witches can cast magic, they must avoid being seen by ordinary people while casting. While Coco does her chores, she daydreams of becoming a witch. When a young witch named Qifrey visits her village, Coco uncovers the “absolute secret,” becomes Qifrey’s apprentice, and begins her studies. This is the story of children who encounter despair, yet reach out toward hope.
tv:196950.tagline: No one can ever know — the witch's absolute secret.
tv:196950.title: Witch Hat Atelier

tv:255650.overview: Four old friends, Massimo, Mattia, Luigi and Riccardo, juggle relationships, careers and dating in a modern world set on giving masculinity a hard time.
tv:255650.title: Real Men

tv:260650.overview: When young Catholic teacher Cushla falls for a married Protestant man, their secret passion ignites a dangerous love that defies the Troubles divide.
tv:260650.title: Trespasses

tv:278050.overview: On the way home from school one day, Konoha Koga rescues Satoko Kusagakure, a ninja who escaped her village. Soon, pursuers from the village show up in search of Satoko only to be deftly dealt with by Konoha. As it turns out, the unassuming high schooler is actually an assassin. Thus, the potentially cutthroat cohabitation of a ninja and an assassin begins!
tv:278050.title: A Ninja and an Assassin Under One Roof

tv:287450.overview: A British intelligence officer Kate Henderson races against time to uncover a UK politician's potential ties with the Kremlin, risking her reputation and family, as a murder and election loom.
tv:287450.tagline: When the enemy is closer than you think, who do you trust?
tv:287450.title: Secret Service

tv:291350.overview: Anna Pigeon flees city life for the solitude of America's stunning national parks following a devastating loss; while Anna tries to outrun her demons, her focus turns to solving crimes that have taken place within national park grounds.
tv:291350.title: Anna Pigeon

tv:293550.overview: The series Gomorrah - The Origins explores Pietro Savastano's youth in the 1970s, in a Naples undergoing a transformation, poverty-stricken and plagued by cigarette smuggling. The story begins in 1977 with a very young Pietro, the son of no one, growing up as an adoptive brother in a family in the poorest part of Secondigliano. A street kid, he scrapes by as best he can, dreaming of a well-being that is still denied him. The story unfolds through Pietro's loss of innocence, along with his brothers and lifelong friends, their ambitions, and his first great love, which, like that of every teenager, will be wild and passionate. His encounter with Angelo, known as 'A Sirena,' the regent of Secondigliano, marks his entry into the world of crime. Through violence, alliances, and betrayals, Pietro discovers the price that life takes.
tv:293550.title: Gomorrah: The Origins

tv:3750.overview: Hotshot plastic surgeons Dr. Sean McNamara and Dr. Christian Troy experience full-blown midlife crises as they confront career, family and romance problems.
tv:3750.tagline: Tell me what you don't like about yourself...?
tv:3750.title: Nip/Tuck

tv:45950.overview: Issei Hyodo is your average perverted high school student whose one wish in life is to have his own harem, but he's got to be one of the unluckiest guys around. He goes on his first date with a girl only to get brutally attacked and killed when it turns out the girl is really a vicious fallen angel. To top it all off, he's later reincarnated as a devil by his gorgeous senpai who tells him that she is also a devil and now his master! One thing's for sure, his peaceful days are over. In a battle between devils and angels, who will win?
tv:45950.tagline: Fueled by the fires of perversion!
tv:45950.title: High School DxD

tv:47450.overview:
In a land controlled by feudal barons, a great warrior and a young boy embark on a journey across a dangerous land to find enlightenment. 

A genre-bending martial arts series very loosely based on the classic Chinese tale Journey to the West.
tv:47450.title: Into the Badlands

tv:54650.overview: A successful New York entrepreneur lives a double life as the head of a drug empire that serves only the rich and influential, all while wanting to escape the underworld and keep his family safe.
tv:54650.title: Power

tv:62650.overview: An emotional thrill ride through the day-to-day chaos of the city's most explosive hospital and the courageous team of doctors who hold it together. They will tackle unique new cases inspired by topical events, forging fiery relationships in the pulse-pounding pandemonium of the emergency room.
tv:62650.title: Chicago Med

tv:69050.overview: Set in the present, the series offers a bold, subversive take on Archie, Betty, Veronica and their friends, exploring the surreality of small-town life, the darkness and weirdness bubbling beneath Riverdale’s wholesome facade.
tv:69050.tagline: To save the future, they must survive the past.
tv:69050.title: Riverdale

tv:72350.overview: The adventures of billionaire Scrooge McDuck and his nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie, their famous uncle Donald Duck, pilot extraordinaire Launchpad, Mrs. Beakly, Webby and Roboduck. Adventures and hidden treasures are everywhere, in their hometown Duckburg and all around the world.
tv:72350.title: DuckTales

tv:75450.overview: A team of young superheroes led by Nightwing (formerly Batman's first Robin) form to combat evil and other perils.
tv:75450.tagline: Heroes will rise ... or Gotham will fall.
tv:75450.title: Titans

tv:80350.overview: The new medical director breaks the rules to heal the system at America's oldest public hospital. Max Goodwin sets out to tear up the bureaucracy and provide exceptional care, but the doctors and staff are not so sure he can succeed. They've heard this before. Not taking "no" for an answer, Dr. Goodwin's instinctive response to problems large and small is four simple words: "How can I help?" He has to disrupt the status quo and prove he'll stop at nothing to breathe new life into this underfunded and underappreciated hospital, returning it to the glory that put it on the map.
tv:80350.tagline: Break the rules. Heal the system.
tv:80350.title: New Amsterdam
